title: Ollie's Bargain Outlet coming to Manistee in 2027 - NewsBreak
text:
By Abigale Racine ,
9 hours ago Ollie's Bargain Outlet will be located at 1369 Manistee Hwy. in Manistee. (Abigale Racine/Manistee News Advocate) FILER TOWNSHIP — An Ollie's Bargain Outlet is coming to Manistee in May.
The outlet store will be located at 1369 Manistee Hwy. in Filer Township, formerly the location of Marie's Art & More , Gordmans and Peebles.
The space has been vacant since 2025, with the relocation of Marie's Art & More to Scottville. Gordmans opened in September 2019, following its conversion from Peebles by parent company Stage Stores . Gordmans closed in 2020.
Filer Township Downtown Development Authority director Michael Kim anticipates the business will boost the local economy.
"We're very happy to see that site not sit vacant because it's an excellent space," he said. "I think they'll be supplying us with services and goods that we are going to be able to take advantage of, (for) both those that are here 24/7, 365, and those that are here as tourists. They're going (to) bring a lot to our economy and another set of good jobs that are going to be available there all year round."
According to its website , Ollie's has been America's largest retailer of closeout merchandise and excess inventory since 1982. The company says it offers discounts up to 70% off retail prices.
Inventory includes housewares, home improvement, furniture, cookware, food and candy, games, electronics and more.
The company has opened 44 new stores throughout the country so far this year, with three openings planned so far in September, according to its website.
A store opened in Traverse City in March and one opened in Cadillac in July 2025. There are 28 locations in Michigan, including stores in Muskegon and Wyoming.
Learn more about the company at ollies.com .
